name: Supracondylar Fracture of Humerus in Children
tags: supracondylar fracture of humerus in children
definition: Common pediatric elbow fracture just above the condyles, with potential vascular and nerve complications.

core: Median/AIN, radial and ulnar nerve exam

investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Displaced fractures usually require reduction and percutaneous pinning.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna principles may complement recovery only after modern neurovascular care.

patientEducation.summary: Common pediatric elbow fracture just above the condyles, with potential vascular and nerve complications.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
